ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use Clip - System
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use Clip.exe in Scripts Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ImagePath

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045 AND ImagePath = RGX(".*\\(Clipboard\\|i.*"))
